text: うえには　うえが　いたって　ことか…

structure.jp: うえには　うえが　いた
structure.en: above the top there was someone higher
so that's what it means, huh...

patterns.name: 〜ということだ
patterns.explanation: って　こと is the casual form of ということ, 'it means that'. With か the speaker is coming to accept it. いたって　ことか = 'so it means there was one, huh'.
